name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: SearchKeywords
label: Search Keywords
description: The value used to locate the radio button (e.g., 'gender-male', '//input[@name='option1']').

name: WaitForPageLoad
label: Wait for Page Load
description: If true, waits for the page to fully load after selection.

name: TimeoutForPageLoad
label: Timeout for Page Load
description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the page to load.

name: IfDialogAppears
label: Handle Dialog
description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after selecting the radio button.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: The name of the button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').
